name: zclass_world_get_pending_fog_density
description: zClass_World::GetPendingFogDensity reads the pending fog density through the world class data and returns 0.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450b80 validates fastcall world in ecx, outDensity in edx, direct read of worldData fog density at offset 0x30, return 0, and no callees.
The native smoke sets pending fog density and verifies GetPendingFogDensity returns the stored value before ApplyPendingFogSettings consumes it.
